# Data Source S3 Bucket

Retrieves the specified S3 bucket in the SVM

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver object-store-server bucket show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.8 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_s3_bucket" "s3_bucket" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "csahu-test-bucket"
  svm_name = "svm1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) The name of the S3 or NAS bucket.
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

### Read-Only

- `audit_event_selector` (Attributes) The audit event selector configuration for the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit_event_selector))
- `comment` (String) Additional information about the bucket.
- `nas_path` (String) The NAS path to which the NAS bucket corresponds.
- `policy` (Attributes) Access policy configuration for the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy))
- `qos_policy` (Attributes) The QoS policy configuration for the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qos_policy))
- `size` (Number) The size of the S3 bucket in bytes.
- `snapshot_policy` (String) The snapshot policy for the bucket.
- `type` (String) The type of the bucket.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the S3 bucket.
- `versioning_state` (String) The versioning state of the bucket.
